constitution.amend: proposed by the Chamber of Deputies or by the monarch to the Chamber; passage requires at least two-thirds majority vote by the Chamber in two successive readings three months apart; a referendum can be substituted for the second reading if approved by more than a quarter of the Chamber members or by 25,000 valid voters; adoption by referendum requires a majority of all valid voters

courts.highest: Supreme Court of Justice includes Court of Appeal and Court of Cassation (consists of 27 judges on 9 benches); Constitutional Court (consists of 9 members)
courts.judges: judges of both courts appointed by the monarch for life
courts.lower: Court of Accounts; district and local tribunals and courts

citizenship.birth: limited to situations where the parents are either unknown, stateless, or when the nationality law of the parents' state of origin does not permit acquisition of citizenship by descent when the birth occurs outside of national territory
citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Luxembourg

suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
world: accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
